description: This file defines the ArrayModel class within the OrangeHRM Core API V2, which implements the Normalizable interface. The class encapsulates an array of data and provides a method to return this data as an array.

classes.name: ArrayModel
classes.description: A model class that encapsulates an array of data and implements the Normalizable interface.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ArrayModel with a data array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the encapsulated data as an array.
